connector.name: PolyDoc
connector.registryDescription: PolyDoc MCP server: HTML/URL to PDF, screenshots, and EU e-invoice generation for MCP clients.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package polydoc-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace tech.polydoc, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: POLYDOC_SANDBOX
env.description: Default sandbox mode (watermarked, does not use production quota). A tool call can override per request. Defaults to false.

env.name: POLYDOC_BASE_URL
env.description: Override for self-hosted or staging use. Defaults to https://api.polydoc.tech.

env.name: POLYDOC_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Directory downloads are written to. Defaults to the OS temp dir + /polydoc.
